bahrain.title: MPs propose emergency soft loans for struggling SMEs
bahrain.summary: Five MPs led by Abdulwahid Qarata filed an urgent proposal for government-backed soft loans and easier liquidity financing for Bahraini companies, especially small and medium firms struggling to meet financial and operating commitments. The aim is to protect jobs and keep the market active.

bahrain.title: Parliament backs age limits and parental oversight for children on social media
bahrain.summary: MPs unanimously approved a proposed Child Law amendment letting authorities regulate children's access to social media. Rules on registration and account opening would depend on age and require parental or guardian supervision. Cabinet will now draft it as formal legislation.

bahrain.title: MPs press government on foreign hiring, runaway workers and frozen salary grades
bahrain.summary: In a debate on 50 government responses, MPs raised continued recruitment of foreign workers despite thousands of unemployed Bahrainis, runaway domestic workers allegedly employed in hotels, heavy trucks in residential areas and frozen government salary grades. They also called for reform of the parallel Bahrainisation system.

bahrain.title: Plan to give defendants a month to challenge criminal orders put on hold
bahrain.summary: A proposed change to Article 277 of the Criminal Procedure Law, extending the time to challenge criminal orders from seven days to a month, was paused after Justice Minister Nawaf Al Maawda warned it could slow the resolution of thousands of cases.

bahrain.title: NBB third-quarter profit falls 12% to BD 17 million
bahrain.summary: National Bank of Bahrain reported Q3 2026 net profit attributable to shareholders of BD 17 million ($45.1 million), down 12% from the same quarter last year. Profit for the first nine months reached BD 60.1 million.

bahrain.title: King Hamad meets Saudi Crown Prince in Riyadh
bahrain.summary: King Hamad met Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Prince Mohammed bin Salman in Riyadh during a visit to Saudi Arabia, joined by Bahrain's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Prince Salman bin Hamad. The talks underline close ties between the two neighbours.

bahrain.title: King creates National Resilience Shield award for wartime community efforts
bahrain.summary: A royal order establishes the National Resilience Shield, to be awarded to companies, civil society groups, professional bodies, unions, sports clubs and others whose efforts made a significant impact in dealing with the effects of the Iranian hostilities and supporting national unity.

crypto.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows reach $1.6 billion in November as price sits near $74,000
crypto.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $95 million on Tuesday, taking November outflows to about $1.6 billion, while stock ETFs drew heavy dip buying. Daily outflows are slowing, but CryptoQuant rates conditions extremely bearish and sees $73,200 as key support. Bitcoin traded near $74,000, down 5.2% in a week.

crypto.title: 21 banks commit $270 million to Project Faro dollar stablecoin
crypto.summary: A consortium including Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, Santander, Deutsche Bank and BBVA committed about $270 million, enough for five years of operations, to Project Faro. It plans a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027, with a euro coin to follow, in a market where USDT and USDC hold about 85%.

crypto.title: OKX and NYSE owner ICE to launch tokenized stock trading on 23 November
crypto.summary: OKXICE will offer eligible US customers round-the-clock trading of more than 70 assets, including 59 ETFs and tokenized shares of Coinbase, Circle and Strategy, under the SEC's temporary Innovation Exemption. 67 companies, including JPMorgan and Coca-Cola, objected to having their shares listed.

crypto.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for institutional clients
crypto.summary: Germany's largest lender went live with custody for Bitcoin, Ether and stablecoins such as USDC and EURC, holding clients' keys under a MiCA licence supervised by BaFin. It plans to expand to Asian financial centres in 2027 and will explore tokenized money market funds with its asset management arm.

crypto.title: Across Protocol domain hijacked, users' wallets drained via phishing site
crypto.summary: A social engineering attack on registrar Namecheap let hackers take over the across.to domain and swap in a phishing site, draining some users' wallets. Across, the third largest cross-chain bridge by 30-day volume, has regained control and says all affected users will be made whole. Total losses are not yet known.

crypto.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC in six weeks
crypto.summary: According to the headline, miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for about $1.1 billion over six weeks and plans to sell more.
